title: Decoupled Prune-and-Reconstruct: Training on a Compact Core with Double-Layer Sparsification
abstract: arXiv:2610.34140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On million-node graphs, the memory wall arrives before the compute wall: a GNN that never fits in VRAM cannot deliver the all-node inference its accuracy promises. The standard remedy, pruning, has always been an accuracy tax - paid once and never refunded. DPR refuses this framing. Its central insight is that the mask that shrinks training can also scaffold recovery: one compact node set bounds both computations of graph learning, serving as the encoder's training graph and, at inference, as the anchor from which a sparse structure-aware decoder rebuilds every pruned node (double-layer sparsification). The order is inverted - prune for efficiency, then reconstruct for accuracy - and the tax is repaid: the deployed 30%-budget model trains in 1,450 MiB of peak memory on one 6 GB GPU and recovers 96.9% of its dense-reconstruction reference, beating a same-GPU rerun of the edge-sparsification baseline DSpar by +1.36 pp at 50.1% lower peak

translated_title: 解耦剪枝与重建：基于双层稀疏化在紧凑核心上训练
translated_abstract: 在百万节点规模的图上，内存墙先于算力墙到来：一个永远无法装入显存的GNN，无法兑现其精度所承诺的全节点推理。标准的补救手段——剪枝，向来是一笔精度税，一次性付出、永不返还。DPR拒绝了这一框架。其核心洞察是：用于缩减训练的掩码同样可以作为恢复的支架——一个紧凑的节点集合同时约束了图学习的两处计算，既充当编码器的训练图，又在推理时作为锚点，稀疏的结构感知解码器由此重建每一个被剪掉的节点（双层稀疏化）。顺序被颠倒——先为效率而剪枝，再为精度而重建——这笔税被偿还了：部署的30%预算模型在单张6 GB GPU上仅以1,450 MiB的峰值内存完成训练，恢复了稠密重建参考性能的96.9%，在同一GPU上重跑的边稀疏化基线DSpar之上提升1.36个百分点，峰值内存还降低了50.1%。
tldr: DPR提出解耦的剪枝-重建框架，通过一个紧凑节点集同时充当编码器的训练图与推理时重建锚点（双层稀疏化），先剪枝换效率、再重建保精度，使模型在单张6 GB GPU上以仅1,450 MiB峰值内存训练即恢复96.9%的稠密参考精度，并以低50.1%的峰值内存超越DSpar基线1.36个百分点。
en_tdlr: DPR decouples pruning and reconstruction by using a single compact node set as both the encoder's training graph and the anchor from which a sparse structure-aware decoder rebuilds pruned nodes (double-layer sparsification), first pruning for efficiency then reconstructing for accuracy, recovering 96.9% of dense-reference accuracy with only 1,450 MiB peak memory on a 6 GB GPU and beating DSpar by +1.36 pp at 50.1% lower peak.
